---
title: "Impact"
---

## Policy and practice

- **Indicators adopted into global monitoring frameworks.** Food Systems Countdown Initiative indicators I helped design have been incorporated into the [CAADP](https://www.foodcountdown.org/) framework and into [FAOSTAT](https://www.fao.org/faostat/), extending their use well beyond the original research.
- **Policy reports with global reach.** The Food Systems Countdown Initiative's annual assessments are released as FAO policy reports with executive summaries in six languages:
  - [The state of food systems worldwide in the countdown to 2030 (2023)](https://www.fao.org/documents/card/en/c/cc8697en)
  - [Governance and resilience as entry points for transforming food systems (2025)](https://openknowledge.fao.org/items/78839aee-a0f2-4741-aade-67e526f962f6)
- **FAO Statistics Working Papers** on employment and value added in agrifood systems, informing how national statistical offices and international agencies measure and report on the agrifood workforce. See [Estimating global and country-level employment in agrifood systems](https://www.fao.org/documents/card/en/c/cc4337en).
- **USDA-funded consumer research** on diet quality and food price sensitivity, supported by the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation and USDA Economic Research Service — see the [USDA press release](https://www.ers.usda.gov/newsroom/trending-topics/news-release-ers-announces-1-4m-in-research-grants-to-improve-equitable-healthy-food-access-in-partnership-with-robert-wood-johnson-foundation/).

## Open data and reproducibility

All of my empirical work is released with public replication code and data wherever possible, through [GitHub](https://github.com/KateSchneider-FoodPol) and [Harvard Dataverse](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/Kate_Schneider) — see each entry on the [Publications](publications.qmd) page for direct links.

- **Invited keynotes & plenary presentations:**
  - "Interactions across food systems" (Invited Keynote) — UVM Food Systems Summit, University of Vermont, September 2024
  - "The state of food systems worldwide" (Invited Keynote) — Paths to Sustainable Food Systems Conference, Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), Oslo, Norway, April 2024
  - "Estimating global and country-level employment in agrifood systems" (Plenary) — 9th International Conference on Agricultural Statistics, Washington, DC, May 2023
- Invited and selected presentations at the Agricultural & Applied Economics Association (AAEA) annual meetings, the Association for Public Policy Analysis & Management (APPAM) fall conferences, the International Conference of Agricultural Economics (ICAE), the AAAS Forum on Science & Technology Policy, the Tata-Cornell Institute 10th Anniversary Conference, and invited departmental seminars (e.g., Michigan State University)

- **Optimizing human health and nutrition: from soil to society** (2022–2027) — U.S. Department of Agriculture, sub-award from Washington State University (total award: $10 million). PI: Andrew Thorne-Lyman.
- **Food Systems Countdown Report** (2021–2022) — Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs sub-award from GAIN. PI: Jessica Fanzo.
